description.value: Prospera Place is a 6,886-seat sports and entertainment arena in the heart of downtown Kelowna, home to the WHL's Kelowna Rockets since opening in 1999. The venue hosts a wide range of events from major concerts and comedy shows to championship hockey, and includes an on-site restaurant called Manhattan Point. Touring cyclists passing through Kelowna may find events of interest, though the venue is primarily a ticketed event facility.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 41m; stands (9 spaces) at 50m; lockers (secure) at 52m; lockers (secure) at 53m; rack at 91m. Total: 9 spaces.
